newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - NAMIBIA BREWERIES LEADS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - NAMIBIA BREWERIES LEADS TRADE.

text.p: the Namibian Stock Exchange last week trading mainly at N$2.50
touching a high of N$2.52 on Tuesday.
Ocean Diamond continued to rise, ending the week at N$5.40
There was also persistent buying interest in leisure and
communications group Servgro and in abbatoir, meat and leather
group Kolosus, but in both companies shares moved in a narrow
The total value traded during the week was N$4.9 million
from N$6.6 million previously, with a volume of 707,800 shares
from 312,194 shares. The NSE overall index ended the week at
